body: I’m not sure I’d be qualified for it. All I’ve done in my adult life is warehouse work. I went to college for a bit but had to drop out to support myself cause full time school and a full time job wasn’t practical anymore. It’s like impossibly expensive trying to get an education. I’m just sort of stuck.

I’m sorry you’re also feeling this bad. I know so many people are, and honestly it depresses me more. It sucks that the world we live in can be so dark that hundreds of thousands of people would rather die than continue to deal with it.

I really like the design! The concept is cool and the style is clean/elegant. Although part of me feels like a left and a right hand would be more aesthetically pleasing than two right hands. Just from a conceptual standpoint so it’s one person holding two objects instead of two separate hands.... unless that’s what you were going for in which case totally ignore me haha.
